part.text:
I've set up the tools and started the design record. Before the INTENT stage I need some answers from you. The design files only allow facts you state, so I haven't assumed anything below.

**Done so far (GROUND stage)**
- The tool check passed: FreeCAD, CadQuery, build123d, the viewer and the renderer are all in place. A background warm-up is running.
- I created the design record from the template and filled it in from your brief. The record checker passes on it (`validate.py`: ok).
- I wrote five requirements: strength under 200 N + 15 N, tip deflection under 2 mm, the rail mounting, the shelf screws, and 6061-T6 CNC from a bureau ×20.

Files:
/scratch/bench-run/project/hw/product.yaml
/scratch/bench-run/project/hw/requirements.yaml
/scratch/bench-run/project/hw/verification.csv

**First numbers, for context (rough hand estimates, not checked results)**
- The bending moment at the wall is about 200 N × 250 mm + 15 N × ~125 mm ≈ 52 N·m.
- If the bracket pivots on its bottom edge, the top M6 screw pulls out at roughly 0.6–0.7 kN. The rivet-nut rating therefore matters for safety.
- The 2 mm deflection limit will probably decide the section size more than strength does. The material data I have for 6061-T6 has no stiffness (Young's modulus) value, so I'll need a sourced figure later.

**Questions** (short answers are fine; "accept" takes the suggestion in brackets)

| # | Question |
|---|---|
| Q-001 | Are these 20 brackets finished parts for real use, or a prototype first? [finished parts] |
| Q-003 | Operating temperature range, and any heat sources nearby? [10–35 °C, none] |
| Q-004 | Any oils, coolants or solvents near the shelving? Is the rail painted, galvanised or bare? Bracket finish: bare, bead-blasted or clear anodised? (Aluminium touching steel can corrode, which is why I ask.) [no chemicals; clear anodised] |
| Q-005 | Is the 200 N sustained (stored items), occasional, or can it come with impact? Any sideways or upward loads? Is the 200 N per bracket? [sustained, per bracket, no impact] |
| Q-006 | Design life in years, and roughly how often the shelf is loaded and unloaded? [10 years, light use] |
| Q-007 | Any looks or finish needs (visible faces, rounded edges)? [break sharp edges, no other looks requirement] |
| Q-008 | What happens if it fails: do people work under the shelf? Any standards or house rules? Who approves the design? |
| Q-009 | Budget per bracket or for the batch, and lead time? |
| Q-010 | Which CNC bureau? Can you share its smallest inside corner radius, the tolerances it can hold, whether it cuts from plate or bar, and whether it supplies a 3.1 material certificate? Does it also do the finishing? |
| Q-011 | What must the release be backed by: analysis only (hand calculation + FEA), or will you also load-test a first bracket, e.g. at 300 N? |
| Q-012 | Fitting order: bracket onto the rail first, then the shelf screwed on from below? Hex key used from the front? [yes] |
| Q-013 | General tolerance for the drawings? [ISO 2768-mK] |
| Q-014 | Rivet nuts: make, steel or aluminium, rated pull-out force and maximum torque? Does the rail stand off the wall (a channel) or lie flat on it? Must the bracket's back plate stay within the 40 mm rail face? |
| Q-015 | Cap screws: strength class, finish and length (8.8 zinc or A2-70 stainless)? Wood screws: head, drive type and material? |
| Q-016 | What safety factor on yield must the bracket keep under the 215 N case? [2.0] |

**Two setup questions**
- **Results in git:** should generated results (STEP, GLB, renders, check results) be stored in git, with Git LFS for STEP and GLB? Or kept out of git? I need this answer before the first build.
- **Documentation depth:** the record is set to `pro` (between `maker` and `regulated`). Keep that?

Once you answer, I'll record the answers and move on to INTENT, where I compare the full design and manufacturing options and ask for your approval. Then come the concept variants, the VARIANT gate and the L1 LAYOUT with its freeze gate. Nothing moves forward until you reply.
